summary: Receives high-speed CHOP data from Touch Out CHOP in another TouchDesigner process over TouchDesigner-optimized TCP/IP or UDP protocols.
key_concepts: Touch In CHOP is the client-side receiver for high-speed TouchDesigner-to-TouchDesigner CHOP data from Touch Out CHOP.
A Touch In connection must exist before useful data is sent from the Touch Out server.
The operator usually receives time-sliced data to reduce frame drops when sender or receiver misses realtime frame rate.
It can also receive non-time-sliced full channel data when full samples are required.
Info CHOP queue channels such as queue length, advanced total, and retarded total diagnose timing and buffering problems.
Protocol, address, port, queue target, maximum queue, adjust time, recover, and synced-port settings shape network timing and recovery.

key_params.name: protocol
key_params.note: Streaming TCP/IP, messaging UDP, multicast UDP, or other network mode

key_params.name: syncports
key_params.note: Synchronize port behavior with paired Touch Out

common_gotchas: Touch In is optimized for TouchDesigner-to-TouchDesigner CHOP communication; use Pipe In CHOP or TCP/IP DAT for other software/devices.
A connection must be established before data is sent from Touch Out.
Data is usually received as time slices to reduce frame dropping when sender or receiver misses target frame rate.
Attach Info CHOP and monitor queue_length, queue_advanced_total, and queue_retarded_total for timing issues.
Use non-time-sliced mode only when full channel data is required.
